findings.finding: The old API has no 415 answer. A session write must be same-origin JSON (backend/http.ts isSameOriginJsonWrite: Origin equals the request origin and the media type is application/json); any other content type answers the dispatcher's origin refusal, 403 origin_forbidden, with or without a message per dispatcher (see the origin rows).

A malformed, oversized or non-object JSON body read through readJsonObject is null; requireJsonObject answers 400 {error: invalid_request, message: "Request body must be a JSON object"}, and routes that read with readJsonObject answer their own 400 code (listed per route in routes.json).

Pages session routes read bounded JSON with readBoundedJson and do not answer 413: an oversized body is the same 400 as malformed JSON. The trace API reads with readLimitedBody and answers 413 {error: payload_too_large, message: "Request body exceeds <limit> bytes"} and 400 invalid_content_length for a non-decimal Content-Length.
exactKeys answers 400 {error: invalid_request, message: "Request body has unexpected fields"} for a missing required key or an extra key.

requireActor answers 400 invalid_expected_actor for a header that is not ^[1-9]\d{0,19}$ and 403 actor_changed for another account. The Points dispute routes check the header themselves and answer 409 {error: account_changed} (no message) for another account and do not validate its format. The notifications and email routes answer the same codes with {error} only (errorOnly mapping).

Points POST routes: 20 per minute per cf-connecting-ip (scope points-web), 429 {error: rate_limited} with retry-after. Identity start and poll: Workers rate-limit binding then the exact D1 window (12 per minute for start, 120 for poll), 429 {error: rate_limited, message: "Too many requests. Try again later."} with retry-after, and 503 {error: service_unavailable, message: "Identity service is temporarily unavailable."} when the limiter fails.

apiErrorResponse (backend/http.ts) maps a thrown refusal to its status and {error, message}; a code that is not ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$ becomes internal_error, a 5xx message becomes "Internal error" unless the dispatcher marks it public, and any other failure is 500 {error: internal_error, message: "Internal error"}.
